Silver or silver-washed coin. Denarius of Septimius Severus (193-211), as kindly identified by the finder. Possibly an irregular issue or contemporary forgery. Obverse description: Bust laureate right, pointed beard and curly hair. Obverse inscription: [--]P SEV[---]V AVG IMP [--]?COS[--]. Reverse description: Victory advancing or floating left holding wreath extended. Reverse inscription: [---]…
